title: Implement generic SecurityExecutionEngine bridge
purpose: Provide a single API AgentCore can call to prepare, execute, observe, verify, seal, or roll back a step.
scope: Define SecurityExecutionEngine trait with prepare, execute, observe, verify, seal, rollback, and explain operations.
Wire prepare through ToolRouter, PolicyEvaluator, CapabilityLease, SandboxCompiler, AuditJournal, and rollback preparation as needed.
Ensure execute can only run after a valid prepared envelope.
Ensure write-with-diff steps prepare shadow diff and rollback handle before commit.
Ensure read-only steps use sandbox executor and zero persistent side effects.
Return structured errors that AgentCore can map to Suspended, Denied, RollbackPending, or FailedClosed.
deliverables: Bridge tests covering read-only, write-with-diff, execute-with-confirmation, denied, and paused steps
acceptance_criteria: AgentCore has one execution API for all effects.
Denied and paused steps do not prepare effects.
Prepared write steps include rollback handles.
Read-only steps run under sandbox profile.
Execution errors are auditable and recoverable.
verification: Run existing policy, sandbox, rollback, and audit tests.
Attempt to call execute without prepare and confirm rejection.
Inspect EffectEnvelope lifecycle for each risk class.
risk_notes: This bridge is the choke point that keeps generic Agent execution from becoming generic shell execution.
implementation_steps: Define SecurityExecutionEngine trait with prepare, execute, observe, verify, seal, rollback, and explain operations.
Implement the default engine over ToolRouter, PolicyEvaluator, CapabilityLease, SandboxProfile, EffectEnvelope, AuditJournal, and rollback handles.
Return denied or paused results without preparing effects.
Prepare write-with-diff rollback handles before execution.
Run read-only tools under lease-derived sandbox profiles.
Return structured errors that AgentCore can map to Suspended, Denied, RollbackPending, or FailedClosed.
failure_modes: execute can be called without a prepared envelope.
Write effect lacks rollback handle before execution.
Denied or paused path prepares effect.
Engine error loses audit or recovery evidence.
AgentCore has more than one side-effect API.

verification_matrix.expected: prepare, execute, observe, verify, seal, rollback, denied, paused, and explain tests pass

verification_matrix.command: cargo test -p agentd security_execution::policy_adapter && cargo test -p agentd security_execution::sandbox_profile && cargo test -p agentd rollback:: && cargo test -p agentd audit::
verification_matrix.expected: policy, sandbox, rollback, and audit contracts remain compatible
AgentCore can only execute through SecurityExecutionEngine

blocked_until: AgentCore has one generic execution API.
Denied and paused steps prepare no effect.
Write steps include rollback handles before execution.
